title: 1 Enoch 18 — The seven mountains of God and the prison of the fallen stars

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον τοὺς θησαυροὺς τῶν ἀνέμων πάντων· καὶ εἶδον ὅτι ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐκόσμησεν πᾶσαν τὴν κτίσιν καὶ τοὺς θεμελίους τῆς γῆς.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon tous thēsaurous tōn anemōn pantōn; kai eidon hoti en autois ekosmēsen pasan tēn ktisin kai tous themelious tēs gēs.

i18n.en: And I saw the storehouses of all the winds; and I saw that by them he has ordered all creation and the foundations of the earth.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον τὸν λίθον τῆς γωνίας τῆς γῆς· καὶ εἶδον τοὺς τέσσαρας ἀνέμους τοὺς βαστάζοντας τὴν γῆν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon ton lithon tēs gōnias tēs gēs; kai eidon tous tessaras anemous tous bastazontas tēn gēn kai to stereōma tou ouranou.

i18n.en: And I saw the cornerstone of the earth; and I saw the four winds which bear up the earth and the firmament of heaven.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον ὅτι οἱ ἄνεμοι ἐκτείνουσιν τὰ ὕψη τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἑστήκασιν ἀνὰ μέσον οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς· οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ στῦλοι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon hoti hoi anemoi ekteinousin ta hypsē tou ouranou, kai hestēkasin ana meson ouranou kai gēs; houtoi eisin hoi styloi tou ouranou.

i18n.en: And I saw that the winds stretch out the heights of heaven, and stand between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of heaven.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον τοὺς ἀνέμους τοῦ οὐρανοῦ στρέφοντας καὶ ἐπιφέροντας τὸν τροχὸν τοῦ ἡλίου, καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀστέρας.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon tous anemous tou ouranou strephontas kai epipherontas ton trochon tou hēliou, kai pantas tous asteras.

i18n.en: And I saw the winds of heaven turning and bringing along the orb of the sun, and all the stars.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον τοὺς ἀνέμους ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς βαστάζοντας τὰς νεφέλας. Καὶ εἶδον τὰς ὁδοὺς τῶν ἀγγέλων· εἶδον ἐπὶ τοῦ πέρατος τῆς γῆς τὸ στερέωμα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπάνω.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon tous anemous epi tēs gēs bastazontas tas nephelas. Kai eidon tas hodous tōn angelōn; eidon epi tou peratos tēs gēs to stereōma tou ouranou epanō.

i18n.en: And I saw the winds upon the earth bearing the clouds. And I saw the paths of the angels; I saw at the end of the earth the firmament of heaven above.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ διώδευσα καὶ εἶδον τόπον καιόμενον νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας, ὅπου ἑπτὰ ὄρη ἐκ λίθων πολυτελῶν, τρία πρὸς ἀνατολὰς καὶ τρία πρὸς νότον.
paragraphs.translit: Kai diōdeusa kai eidon topon kaiomenon nyktos kai hēmeras, hopou hepta orē ek lithōn polytelōn, tria pros anatolas kai tria pros noton.

i18n.en: And I passed on and saw a place which burns night and day, where there are seven mountains of precious stones, three toward the east and three toward the south.

notes.official: **The seven mountains of God** — the first of the two 1 Enoch cosmographic seven-mountain passages (the second is 1 En 24-25). The cosmography extends the existing 5-tradition cosmic-mountain cluster (Sinai/Horeb + Ṣapunu + Nimush/Ararat/Jūdī + mountain-as-revelation-site + Eden-mountain) to a **6-tradition cluster** by adding 1 Enoch 18 + 24-25. See central entry `seven-mountains-of-god-1-enoch-18-24-cosmic-mountain-cluster-extension-cross-corpus`. Bidirectional with v2.57.0 `mount-sapunu-tsafon-cosmic-mountain-cross-corpus-ugaritic-hebrew-bible`, v2.61.0 `har-sinai-horev-the-mountain-of-Elohim-divine-mountain-cross-corpus`, v2.65.0 `mt-nimush-nisir-ararat-judi-flood-mountain-landing-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ τῶν πρὸς ἀνατολὰς ἓν ἐκ λίθου χρωματιστοῦ, καὶ ἓν ἐκ μαργαρίτου, καὶ ἓν ἐξ ἰάσπεως· καὶ τὰ τοῦ νότου ἐκ λίθου ἐρυθροῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai tōn pros anatolas hen ek lithou chrōmatistou, kai hen ek margaritou, kai hen ex iaspeōs; kai ta tou notou ek lithou erythrou.

i18n.en: And of those toward the east, one was of colored stone, and one of pearl, and one of jasper; and those toward the south were of red stone.

paragraphs.text: Τὸ δὲ μέσον αὐτῶν προσήγγιζεν τῷ οὐρανῷ, ὡσεὶ θρόνος θεοῦ ἐκ λίθου ἀλάβαστρου, καὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ θρόνου ἐκ σαπφείρου.
paragraphs.translit: To de meson autōn prosēngizen tō ouranō, hōsei thronos theou ek lithou alabastrou, kai to akron tou thronou ek sappheirou.

i18n.en: And the middle one among them reached to heaven, like the throne of God, of alabaster stone, and the summit of the throne was of sapphire.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον πῦρ φλεγόμενον. Καὶ τὰ πέρα τῶν ὀρέων ἐκείνων εἶδον τόπον, πέρας τῆς μεγάλης γῆς· ἐκεῖ συντελοῦνται οἱ οὐρανοί.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon pyr phlegomenon. Kai ta pera tōn oreōn ekeinōn eidon topon, peras tēs megalēs gēs; ekei syntelountai hoi ouranoi.

i18n.en: And I saw a flaming fire. And beyond those mountains I saw a place — the end of the great earth: there the heavens come to completion.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον χάσμα μέγα ἐν στύλοις πυρὸς οὐρανίου, καὶ εἶδον ἐν αὐτῷ καταβαίνοντας στύλους τοῦ πυρὸς οὐρανίου, οὔτε εἰς μέτρον οὔτε εἰς ὕψος οὔτε εἰς βάθος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon chasma mega en stylois pyros ouraniou, kai eidon en autō katabainontas stylous tou pyros ouraniou, oute eis metron oute eis hypsos oute eis bathos.

i18n.en: And I saw a great chasm with pillars of celestial fire, and I saw within it pillars of celestial fire descending — without measure, without height, without depth.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐπέκεινα τοῦ χάσματος τούτου εἶδον τόπον οὐχ ἔχοντα στερέωμα οὐρανοῦ ἐπάνω, οὔτε γῆν τεθεμελιωμένην ὑποκάτω αὐτοῦ· καὶ ὕδωρ οὐκ ἦν ἐπ' αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐδὲ πετεινά, ἀλλὰ τόπος ἦν ἔρημος καὶ φοβερός.
paragraphs.translit: Kai epekeina tou chasmatos toutou eidon topon ouch echonta stereōma ouranou epanō, oute gēn tethemeliōmenēn hypokatō autou; kai hydōr ouk ēn ep' autou, kai oude peteina, alla topos ēn erēmos kai phoberos.

i18n.en: And beyond this chasm I saw a place which had no firmament of heaven above it, nor any earth firmly founded beneath it; and there was no water upon it, and no birds — but it was a desolate and terrible place.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ τόπον εἶδον ἐκεῖ φοβερόν, οὔτε οὐρανὸν ἄνω οὔτε γῆν τεθεμελιωμένην, ἀλλὰ τόπος ἔρημος καὶ φοβερὸς ἦν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai topon eidon ekei phoberon, oute ouranon anō oute gēn tethemeliōmenēn, alla topos erēmos kai phoberos ēn.

i18n.en: And I saw there a terrible place, with no heaven above and no earth firmly founded — only a desolate and terrible place.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶδον ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ὡς ὄρη μεγάλα καιόμενα, καὶ ὡς πνεύματα μοι ὁ ἐπερωτῶντος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon hepta asteras hōs orē megala kaiomena, kai hōs pneumata moi ho eperōtōntos.

i18n.en: And I saw seven stars like great burning mountains, and like spirits, when I asked about them.

notes.official: **Seven stars like great burning mountains** — the prison for the stars and the host of heaven. The cosmography integrates astronomical-rebellion (stars that failed their orbital-obedience) with angelic-rebellion (the Watchers and the cosmic-host). The integration reflects the broader 1 Enoch interest in astronomical-and-calendrical regularity as cosmic-moral-obligation. See central entry `fallen-stars-prison-1-enoch-18-21-jude-6-2-pet-2-4-cross-corpus`. Bidirectional with Jude 6 + 2 Pet 2:4 NT-allusions.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος· Οὗτος ὁ τόπος τέλος οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς· δεσμωτήριον τοῦτο ἐγένετο τοῖς ἀστράσιν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eipen ho angelos; Houtos ho topos telos ouranou kai gēs; desmōtērion touto egeneto tois astrasin tou ouranou kai tē stratia tou ouranou.

i18n.en: And the angel said: This place is the end of heaven and earth; this has become a prison for the stars of heaven and for the host of heaven.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες οἱ κυλιόμενοι ἐν τῷ πυρὶ οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ παραβάντες τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸ τοῦ ἀνατεῖλαι αὐτούς, ὅτι οὐκ ἦλθον ἐν τῷ καιρῷ αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hoi asteres hoi kyliomenoi en tō pyri houtoi eisin hoi parabantes tēn entolēn tou theou pro tou anateilai autous, hoti ouk ēlthon en tō kairō autōn.

i18n.en: And the stars which roll over in the fire are those which transgressed the commandment of God before their rising, because they did not come at their appointed time.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ὠργίσθη αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτοὺς μέχρι καιροῦ τελειώσεως τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν, ἕως μυρίων ἐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ōrgisthē autois, kai edēsen autous mechri kairou teleiōseōs tēs hamartias autōn, heōs myriōn etōn.

i18n.en: And he was wrathful with them, and bound them until the time of the completion of their sin, until ten thousand years.
